text:
leah: Observed repeated DAST decrypt failures in staging: "permission denied: DecryptKey" on 3 runs. Anyone seeing this?
omar: saw alerts. We rotated scanner service account yesterday during RBAC cleanup. suspect KMS binding missing.
jin: quick check: scanner config points to kms-proxy, not KMS directly. proxy had a deploy earlier today. could be related.
leah: confirmed proxy deploy at 08:12. re-running a job now to reproduce.
deploy-bot: CI #5042: dast-scan failed (decrypt error) - retrying.
jin: still failing. I pulled runner logsstacktrace shows 403 from proxy but I don't see CloudAudit rows for Decrypt in GCP.
nina: weird. if proxy is returning 403 before it reaches KMS, CloudAudit won't show Decrypt attempts. we need to know whether proxy mangled auth headers.
omar: rolling back proxy to v2.7.3 to test.
deploy-bot: kms-proxy rollback to v2.7.3 initiated.
leah: re-run after rollback passed. scanners completed and we see normal decrypt audit rows for proxy SA.
jin: verdict: proxy deploy introduced an auth header regression in an error path. no Decrypt CloudAudit for failed attempts -> compliance gap.
security-bot: Reminder: SEC-LOG-3 mandates 90d evidence retention and immutable audit entries for 365d. Record any missing audit rows in the incident artifact list.
nina: actions: 1) Omar to add scoped temporary KMS permission (1h) to unstick runs 2) Omar/Jin to PR proxy fix + tests for header passthrough 3) Leah to document missing audit rows in incident INC-8123 and include runner/proxy logs 4) Add pre-deploy smoke that calls proxy -> expects CloudAudit entry within 30s.
omar: applying temp RBAC fix now and filing PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kms-proxy/pull/1890
leah: will update incident and check with compliance on evidence gaps. Closing unless it recurs.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-8123 created and updated: status=mitigated.
